bai: Bai 20 PivotTable trong Excel: Table, Pivot Fields, Values, Slicer, Group, PivotChart, Refresh

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chon vung > Insert > Table (Ctrl+T) > tich My table has headers > Table Design dat ten lien nhau (vd DuLieu)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Table tu mo rong khi them dong; Pivot lay ten Table lam Source nen tu cap nhat vung. Ten khong dau cach, khong ky tu la.
cong_thuc.vi_du: A1:F4998 thanh Table 'DuLieu'. Them dong 21/3/2020 Mien Nam SP01 30 ngay duoi Table tu nam vao (vung cham).
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: De ten co space ('Du lieu') gay loi tham chieu; quen tich Headers nen dong tieu de bi tinh thanh data. Khong doi ten de Table1 chung chung kho quan ly.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click 1 o trong Table > Insert > PivotTable > New Worksheet > OK (Source = DuLieu)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nguon la ten Table chu khong phai $A$1:$F$4998 co dinh. Dat sheet moi cho sach; click vung pivot thi hien Pane Fields + tab Analyze/Design.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Source=DuLieu > sheet moi pivot trang cho bao cao 1.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Chon vung co dinh thay vi Table nen them dong moi Pivot khong thay. Dat pivot de len data goc gay de.

cong_thuc.ten: Keo Fields: Filters / Columns / Rows / Values
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Keo Khu vuc>Filters, San pham>Columns, Nha PP>Rows, Doanh thu>Values. Go: keo ra ngoai hoac bo tich.
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Filters loc tren dau; Columns nhom ngang; Rows nhom doc; Values so lieu tinh. Thu tu keo quyet dinh hinh bao cao.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Filters=Khu vuc (chon Mien Bac), Columns=San pham SP01-SP10, Rows=NPP (FPT, Viettel...), Values=Sum Doanh thu.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Keo so vao Rows/Text vao Values nen ra Count vo nghia. Keo 2 field cung o nhung sai thu tu lam bao cao kho doc.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click mui ten field trong Values > Value Field Settings > Summarize by: Sum/Average/Count/Max/Min > OK
cong_thuc.giai_thich: So mac dinh Sum; doi Average xem binh quan, Count dem dong. Moi Values co the tinh khac nhau tren cung pivot.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Keo Doanh thu 2 lan: 1 Sum (Tong), 1 Average (TB).
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: De Count khi muon Sum vi o co text/rong lam Sum thanh Count. Doi Average nhung quen format so le.

cong_thuc.ten: Show Values As: % of Grand Total
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Value Field Settings > Show Values As > % of Grand Total (hoac % of Column/Row Total)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Hien ty trong % thay vi tuyet doi; tong 100%. % of Column/Row khi muon ty trong trong nhom.
cong_thuc.vi_du: SP10 5.24%, SP09 9.16%... Tong 100%. Doi ten cot 'Ty le %' o Formula Bar.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Doc % Grand nhung tuong % nhom nen ket luan sai. Quen doi Number % 2 le nen 5% hien 5.24% kho so.

cong_thuc.ten: Doi ten cot Values + Number Format
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click ten Values > Formula Bar go ten moi (Tong/Trung binh/Ty le) > Enter. Chuot phai gia tri > Number Format > Number: Use 1000 Separator, Decimal 0-2
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Ten mac dinh 'Sum of Doanh thu2' dai; doi gon. Format nghin + le giup de doc tien te/%.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Dat ten trung voi field goc gay loi 'already exists'. Format o ngoai pivot thay vi Number Format nen Refresh mat dinh dang.

cong_thuc.ten: Thu gon +/- , Subtotals, Grand Totals, Layout Tabular
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click +/- thu gon/mo nhom. Design > Subtotals (Show/Hide) | Grand Totals (On/Off Rows&Columns) | Report Layout > Show in Tabular Form
cong_thuc.giai_thich: +/- an hien chi tiet (Mien Bac gom bao nhieu). Subtotals tong nhom; Grand tong chung; Tabular dang bang tach cot ro hon Compact.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Collapse Mien Bac chi thay tong vung. Grand Totals Off bo dong/cot tong khi chi can chi tiet. Tabular hien Khu vuc/San pham/Doanh thu rieng cot.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Tat Subtotals nhung sep can tong nhom thi thieu so. De Compact lam 2 cap nhom don vao 1 cot kho loc.

cong_thuc.ten: Sort + Filter trong Pivot (ke ca Date Filter)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click mui ten field > Sort A-Z/Z-A/More Sort (theo Values). Filter: bo tich Mien Bac; Ngay > Date Filters > chon ngay 3,6
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Sort nhan hoac sort theo tong Values (NPP doanh thu tu be-lon). Date Filter loc thang/ngay nhanh cho field Ngay.
cong_thuc.vi_du: San pham Z-A; NPP sort theo Sum Doanh thu nho->lon de thay yeu nhat. Ngay chi lay 3,6.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Sort nhan chu cai khi muon sort theo so nen thu tu sai. Loc Filters nhung quen Clear khi lam bao cao moi nen thieu du lieu.

cong_thuc.ten: Calculated Field (truong tinh toan, mo rong)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: PivotTable Analyze > Fields, Items & Sets > Calculated Field > Name (vd HoaHong) > Formula =Doanh_thu*0.05 > Add
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Them chi tieu moi tu field co san ma khong sua nguon (vd Hoa hong 5% doanh thu). Tinh tren tong sau gop, khac cot phu Average.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Calculated Field HoaHong = Doanh thu *5%. Keo vao Values thanh cot HH theo NPP.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Ten field sai 1 ky tu (Doanhthu vs Doanh thu) gay #NAME?. Calculated Field voi Average cho ket qua sai vi no Sum truoc chia sau.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chuot phai 1 o Ngay trong pivot > Group > chon Months (+Quarters/Years) > OK. Ungroup de tra lai.
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Ngay le co hang tram gia tri kho slicer/loc; group gom ve Thang/Quy/Nam gon. Khac voi chen cot phu MONTH/YEAR o nguon.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ngay 1/1-31/12 group Months -> pivot hien Jan-Dec thay vi 365 ngay.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Field Ngay co o trong/text nen Group mo bao loi 'Cannot group'. Group ca Months+Years nhung quen bo Days lam nhom sai.

cong_thuc.ten: Cot phu Thang/Nam bang MONTH/YEAR (cach thay the)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Them cot Thang =MONTH(ngay) (vd =MONTH(A2)), Nam =YEAR(A2) trong Table nguon > Refresh > keo Thang/Nam vao Rows/Slicer
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Video goi y cach nay thay vi Group: chu dong, lam Slicer Thang/Nam gon, dung duoc ca khi Ngay loi group. Nho Refresh sau khi them cot.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Them cot Thang, Nam; Slicer Thang (1-12) thay vi hang tram ngay le.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Them cot ngoai Table nen Table khong mo rong, Refresh khong thay cot. MONTH tren o text tra #VALUE!.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click pivot > Analyze > Insert Slicer > tich Nha PP, Ngay > OK. Slicer header > Multi-select (3 o) de chon nhieu; Slicer tab > Columns 2/4 + keo rong
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Slicer la nut loc lon bam thay vi dropdown. Multi-select chon nhieu NPP; Columns chia nut thanh nhieu cot do roi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Slicer Nha PP 2 cot: FPT, Ga Excel, Viettel, VNPT. Bat Multi-select chon FPT+Viettel.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Khong bat Multi-select nen click muc 2 mat muc 1. Slicer che pivot vi khong keo gon/doi Columns.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chuot phai Slicer > Report Connections (PivotTable Connections) > tich het PivotTable1 + PivotTable2 > OK
cong_thuc.giai_thich: 1 slicer dieu khien dong bo ca 2 pivot/chart (bao cao theo Khu vuc + theo San pham). Quen tick 1 pivot thi bao cao do lech.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Slicer NPP noi ca 2 bang; chon FPT thi ca 2 bang chi hien FPT.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Quen tick 1 pivot nen loc slicer 1 bang nhay 1 bang dung yen -> lech so. Nhan ban pivot nhung khong noi lai slicer.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click pivot > Insert > PivotChart > chon Column/Pie > OK. An nut xam: chuot phai Field Button > Hide All Field Buttons on Chart
cong_thuc.giai_thich: PivotChart gan pivot, loc theo pivot. Field Buttons la nut xam tren chart (tien loc) nhung roi khi chup/gui; an cho dep.
cong_thuc.vi_du: PivotChart cot: Mien Nam 40%, Mien Trung 35%. Hide buttons truoc khi copy len Dashboard.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Ve Chart thuong thay vi PivotChart nen chart khong nhay theo slicer. Xoa nham Field Button tuong xoa field that.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Them dong vao Table DuLieu > click pivot > Analyze > Refresh (Refresh All cho all) | Change Data Source =DuLieu de sua nguon
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Pivot khong tu cap nhat real-time; phai Refresh sau khi them/sua nguon. Change de kiem tra/sua ten Table nguon khi loi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Them 21/3/2020 Mien Nam SP01 30 > Refresh All thay tong tang 30 o ca 2 pivot + chart.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Them du lieu ngoai Table + khong Refresh nen so cu. Refresh nhung Source van $A$1:$F$4998 cu nen dong moi khong vao.

cong_thuc.ten: Copy pivot lam bao cao 2 + dinh dang tien
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Boi den ca pivot > Copy > paste o khac (Fields di theo vung moi) > keo lai (vd Khu vuc>Rows). Format #,##0 cho tien.
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Copy nguyen pivot de lam bao cao 2 ma khong keo lai tu dau (1 theo Khu vuc, 1 theo San pham). Dinh dang tach nghin cho tien.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Copy pivot sang phai: bao cao 1 theo San pham, bao cao 2 keo Khu vuc>Rows xem theo vung.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Paste Values thay vi pivot nen mat lien ket Fields. Copy nhung khong doi keo lai nen 2 bang giong het nhau vo nghia.

cau_hoi.cau: Du lieu bai 20 lon co nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Du lieu lon hay doi nen dung Pivot keo tha.

cau_hoi.cau: Truoc khi tao Pivot nen lam gi?
cau_hoi.B: Tao Table (Ctrl+T) + dat ten lien nhau
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Table tu mo rong, Pivot tu cap nhat theo ten.

cau_hoi.cau: Phim tat tao Table la gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ctrl+T mo Create Table.

cau_hoi.cau: Ten Table dat the nao moi dung?
cau_hoi.A: Tuy y dai bao nhieu cung duoc
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ten space gay loi tham chieu Source.

cau_hoi.cau: Them dong moi ngay duoi Table thi sao?
cau_hoi.A: Tu nam vao Table (vung cham mo rong)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Day la loi ich lon nhat cua Table.

cau_hoi.cau: Nguon Pivot sau khi tao Table la gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ten dong tu mo rong theo Table.

cau_hoi.cau: Chen Pivot o dau?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Di tu Table de tu nhan Source.

cau_hoi.cau: Nen dat Pivot moi o dau?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Sheet moi sach, de lam nhieu bao cao.

cau_hoi.cau: Pane quan ly Pivot ten gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chua 4 vung Filters/Columns/Rows/Values.

cau_hoi.cau: 4 o keo trong Fields la gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bon vung keo tha quyet dinh bao cao.

cau_hoi.cau: Keo Khu vuc vao dau de loc tren dau?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Loc Mien Bac/Nam/Trung tren dau pivot.

cau_hoi.cau: Keo San pham vao dau de thanh cot ngang?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Thanh cot SP01-SP10 ngang.

cau_hoi.cau: Keo Nha phan phoi vao dau de thanh hang doc?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Thanh hang doc FPT/Viettel...

cau_hoi.cau: Keo Doanh thu vao dau?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: So lieu de tinh toan.

cau_hoi.cau: So mac dinh trong Values khi keo so la gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: So thi Sum; text thi Count.

cau_hoi.cau: Doi Sum sang Average o dau?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chon Average > OK.

cau_hoi.cau: Xem ty trong % tong thi chon gi?
cau_hoi.A: Show Values As > % of Grand Total

cau_hoi.cau: % of Grand Total va % of Column khac nhau the nao?
cau_hoi.B: Grand: tren tong chung; Column: trong cot nhom
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chon sai mau so dan ket luan sai.

cau_hoi.cau: Doi ten 'Sum of Doanh thu2' dai thi lam the nao?
cau_hoi.C: Click ten > Formula Bar go lai (Tong/TB/Ty le) > Enter
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ten gon de doc; khong trung ten goc.

cau_hoi.cau: So tien xau chua phan cach nghin thi lam gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: 1,234,567 de doc; giam decimal.

cau_hoi.cau: Nut +/- truoc Mien Bac de lam gi?
cau_hoi.A: Thu gon/mo chi tiet trong nhom
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Collapse de chi thay tong vung.

cau_hoi.cau: Tat dong/cot tong chung o dau?
cau_hoi.B: Design > Grand Totals > Off for Rows and Columns
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bo tong khi chi can chi tiet.

cau_hoi.cau: Show in Tabular Form de lam gi?
cau_hoi.C: Hien dang bang tach cot ro (Khu vuc/San pham/Doanh thu)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ro hon Compact khi nhieu cap nhom.

cau_hoi.cau: Sort NPP theo doanh thu tu be den lon thi sort theo gi?
cau_hoi.D: Sort theo Sum of Doanh thu (Values) khong phai ten
cau_hoi.giai_thich: More Sort Options > theo Values.

cau_hoi.cau: Loc Ngay chi thang 3,6 thi dung gi?
cau_hoi.A: Mui ten Ngay > Date Filters/Date Filter chon 3,6
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Date Filter loc nhanh field Ngay.

cau_hoi.cau: Copy pivot sang ben de lam bao cao 2 thi Fields the nao?
cau_hoi.B: Di theo vung paste moi, keo lai tuy y
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Copy nguyen pivot giu lien ket.

cau_hoi.cau: De co bao cao theo Khu vuc ben canh bao cao theo San pham thi lam gi?
cau_hoi.C: Copy pivot roi keo Khu vuc > Rows o vung moi
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tan dung pivot cu, keo lai field.

cau_hoi.cau: Ve bieu do tu pivot thi dung lenh nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: PivotChart gan pivot, nhay theo loc/slicer.

cau_hoi.cau: Nut xam tren PivotChart muon an khi chup bao cao thi lam gi?
cau_hoi.A: Hide All Field Buttons on Chart
cau_hoi.giai_thich: An cho dep, du lieu van giu.

cau_hoi.cau: Chen Slicer o dau?
cau_hoi.B: Click pivot > Analyze > Insert Slicer > tich Nha PP, Ngay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Slicer loc truc quan bang nut bam.

cau_hoi.cau: Chon nhieu NPP tren slicer (FPT + Viettel) thi bat gi?
cau_hoi.C: Multi-select (bieu tuong 3 o) roi tick nhieu
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Khong bat thi chon muc 2 mat muc 1.

cau_hoi.cau: Slicer Ngay co hang tram ngay le thi xu ly gon nhat the nao?
cau_hoi.D: Group Months/Years hoac chen cot Thang=MONTH(), Nam=YEAR() lam slicer
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Group/slicer Thang Nam gon hon tram ngay.

cau_hoi.cau: Group Ngay ve Thang lam the nao?
cau_hoi.A: Chuot phai Ngay trong pivot > Group > chon Months > OK
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Gom 365 ngay ve 12 thang.

cau_hoi.cau: Them cot Thang bang cong thuc nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Lay so thang de slicer/nhom.

cau_hoi.cau: Them cot Nam bang cong thuc nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Lay nam de slicer/nam.

cau_hoi.cau: Lam sao 1 Slicer NPP loc duoc ca 2 pivot?
cau_hoi.A: Ve slicer moi cho moi pivot
cau_hoi.D: Chuot phai Slicer > Report Connections > tich ca 2 pivot
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Noi slicer toi moi PivotTable de dong bo.

cau_hoi.cau: Quen tick 1 pivot trong Report Connections thi sao?
cau_hoi.A: Bang do khong nhay theo, lech so lieu
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Phai tick het de dong bo.

cau_hoi.cau: Them dong 21/3/2020 Mien Nam SP01 30 vao Table roi pivot chua thay thi lam gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Pivot phai Refresh moi nap du lieu moi.

cau_hoi.cau: Kiem tra/sua nguon pivot khi nghi sai vung o dau?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dam bao nguon la ten Table dong.

cau_hoi.cau: Calculated Field Hoa hong 5% doanh thu tao o dau?
cau_hoi.D: Fields, Items & Sets > Calculated Field: =Doanh thu*0.05
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Truong tinh tren tong pivot ma khong sua nguon.

thuat_ngu_chuan.giai_thich: Keo tha phan tich du lieu lon.
Nut loc truc quan cho Pivot.
Nap du lieu moi tu Table vao Pivot.
Chart gan Pivot, nhay theo loc.
